attempts.summary: Deployed PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across node1 (initial primary), node2 and node3 (initial standbys) on CentOS Stream 10, using physical replication slots, scram-sha-256 auth, and firewalld rules opening 5432. Demonstrated failover by stopping node1, promoting node2 via pg_promote() with zero committed-data loss, repointing node3 to stream from node2 on the new timeline, and bringing node1 back online as a standby of node2 (new primary) — all verified with real inserts/counts propagated to all nodes. Then executed the mandatory one-at-a-time native reboot protocol on all three nodes (standbys first, primary last), proving changed boot_id and full data/replication recovery after each restart, ending with node2 still primary and node1/node3 both healthy streaming standbys with 6/6 matching rows.
